title: Customer Information and Feature Explanation
summary: This topic mainly consists of advisor or writer statements informing customers about vehicle features, service details, dealership resources, and operating limitations, with very little explicit sentiment.

positive.summary: The positive example praises directing the customer to a local Live Genius for an in-person walkthrough of vehicle features.

negative.summary: The negative example concerns the customer being told that Service Pack 22 was causing the observed behavior.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples are mostly factual explanations about controls, feature availability, service intervals, dealership contact, and system behavior without clear approval or dissatisfaction.

limitations: Most examples are undetermined, so explicit customer sentiment is limited.
The topic groups several different informational interactions, including feature education, service guidance, dealership referral, and explanation of system limitations, rather than one single issue.
Examples are insufficient to assess broader satisfaction with dealer communication beyond these sampled fragments.
